card.name: Linking words in eye-drop warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as including, with, of and contains, in glaucoma eye-drop warnings. They come just before a drug or product name, or an eye-product term, such as latanoprost or topical ophthalmic products.

modes.label: Before a named eye drug
modes.description: A linking word right before latanoprost or a similar prostaglandin drug name.
modes.example: The combined use of two or more prostaglandins, or prostaglandin analogs<< including>> latanoprost is not recommended.

modes.label: Within keratitis container warnings
modes.description: Words like with and of in the sentence about bacterial keratitis and multiple-dose containers.
modes.example: There have been reports of bacterial keratitis associated<< with>> the use of multiple-dose containers of

modes.label: Product name then contains
modes.description: The verb contains after the product name ROCKLATAN, before the ingredient.
modes.example: 5.4 Intraocular Inflammation ROCKLATAN<< contains>> latanoprost which should be used

card.writes: It pushes the model toward eye-related words such as eye, lashes and blink, mostly in Chinese tokens.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in eye-drop label warnings, just before the next eye-related term is expected.
